unit: One criterion in one complete response; retain subclaim qualifications rather than force a positive label
comparison: Compare newly explicit constraints and falsification obligations, not answer length, jargon counts or number of suggestions
missing_evidence_rule: Models were not given test reports. Failure to name a specific hidden test is not an error; only false evidence claims or unsupported assurance are conflicts. A proposed observation is not an executed result.
review: Principal researcher assesses with source binding; Goodall independently reviews disagreements and limitations. Neither review counts as independent human ground truth.
decision: After all three responses, close this single-family pilot even if no incremental content is observed
